title: Words of Truth, Heart of Lies/Quotes
summary:
"In this world, you have to look out for yourself."
- Zhalia Moon

"… blood of the golem…"
- Eathon Lambert's journal

"All Amulets have Titans in them. That's what makes them Amulets."
- Dante Vale

"Why fight for DeFoe?" (Dante Vale)
"It's my job."
-Grier
